name: Community — MiniMax H3 Emotion TTS Lip-Sync
author: T8mars + IndexTeam + larryvrh
description:
Model format: int8 ConvRot. Steps: 6 by default.

Type the line, pick the mood, get the character saying it. IndexTTS 2.5 speaks your quoted dialogue in the voice you supply, with the emotion you name, and MiniMax H3 lip-syncs the reference character to that speech in one generation.

HOW TO USE IT
1. AUDIO SLOT = a VOICE SAMPLE, 3-10 s of clean speech from the voice you want. It is cloned, not lip-synced. Any language sample works; the spoken line is English.
2. REFERENCE IMAGES = the character(s), up to nine, exactly like the Lip-Sync preset.
3. PROMPT = a normal H3 shot description that contains the line in double quotes. The first "quoted" run of text is what gets spoken, e.g.: A woman in a leather jacket at a microphone, hard blue key light, looks into the camera and says "You are leaving tomorrow, and nobody told me." Static shot.
4. EMOTION (optional) = an [emotion: ...] tag anywhere in the prompt, in plain words: [emotion: angry, clipped], [emotion: sad and tired], [emotion: bright and happy]. The tag is removed from the prompt before H3 sees it. Without a tag the emotion is copied from the voice sample.

The preset prepends the <Audio 1>: fully_copy binding to your prompt automatically. That line is what makes H3 reproduce the speech instead of keeping only the timbre and inventing its own words - three runs without it did exactly that. Do not write your own <Audio 1> line. UPDATE 2026-10-23, USE THE v2 CARD FOR NEW WORK: on short lines this card can speak part of its own hidden instruction ("... as the final audio track ...") into the time after the line, even with the prompt fix - 0 of 3 seeds clean for a 7 word line in a 6 s shot. The v2 card in this pack removes that instruction text and came back word-exact on 3 of 3, with the lips closed and silence after the line.

Verified 2026-09-02 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti (SimpliGen 1.58.2 / engine ComfyUI 0.34.2, weights hand-placed) and again 2026-09-09 on SimpliGen 1.59.2 with the weights fresh-downloaded by the app: a 6 s angry line at 864x480 with one reference image took 191 s end to end through the agent API (307 s on the cold 1.59.2 run with the TTS weights loading from disk for the first time), and the output transcribes word-perfect against the written line, with the mouth on the words and the emotion in the delivery.

WHAT TO EXPECT. The spoken line is trimmed to the shot length. Set the duration to fit the line: IndexTTS speaks about 3-5 words a second, and a line too long for the shot gets rushed or cut off (a 22 word line in a 6 s shot came back with its opening words garbled on 2 of 3 seeds, 2026-10-23). A line SHORTER than the duration needs one thing from your prompt: IndexTTS speaks at roughly five words a second, so a single sentence is about six seconds, and H3 generates audio for the WHOLE shot. Leave the remaining time unclaimed and it fills the gap by repeating and mangling your line - you get extra words you never wrote.

THE PROMPT FIX. After the quoted line write three things: the closure as an event ("the instant that sentence ends, her lips close completely and all speaking motion stops"), an observable end state for the leftover time ("for the entire remainder of the shot she stays silent with her lips closed and still, hands resting on the desk"), and the failure as a prohibition ("she speaks only once, does not repeat any part of the line, and no further words or vocal sound occur"). Verified 2026-09-12: the same 29 word line and the same seed that produced invented words twice came back clean, with 6.4 s of held silence at the end.

WHAT DOES NOT WORK: "do not pad for length", "keep it short", or anything else aimed at the generator rather than the scene - H3 has no referent for it. "She should close her mouth" is weaker than describing the closure happening, and a prompt that only covers the moment speech ends merely relocates the extra words into the unclaimed remainder. If you would rather not write this every time, the Fit to Shot card in this pack paces the line to fill the shot instead - at the cost of never being able to hold a silence. Duration default 6 s. Keep lines to one or two sentences per shot. IndexTTS takes 3-5 s per line plus a one-time model load; the H3 part is the Lip-Sync preset's Turbo chain, 6 steps.

DEPENDENCIES, READ BEFORE INSTALLING. Adds the comfyui-indextts25-T8 custom node (pinned) and 7.7 GB of IndexTTS 2.5 weights into the engine's models/TTS folder. The node pins transformers below 5 and its install DOWNGRADES the engine's transformers (5.15.1 -> 4.57.x). SimpliGen's maintainer has confirmed this is allowed and sticks across engine updates; every other shipped pack has been re-verified against it, but any future pack that pins transformers 5 will conflict with this one in the shared engine. If a later IndexTTS node starts on the first run but cannot find its weights, restart SimpliGen once: the models/TTS folder is registered at engine start. REQUIRES SimpliGen 1.59.2 OR NEWER. IndexTTS 2.5 keeps its weights in folders with a dot in the name, and app versions before 1.59.2 refused to download into those, so the install silently skipped all 26 files. 1.59.2 fixed that rule; verified 2026-09-09 with the weights removed first: the app downloaded all 26 files (7.7 GB) into models/TTS/IndexTTS-2.5 on its own, the engine loaded them from there after one restart, and a 6 s line rendered word-perfect through the agent API. If your app is older, update it before installing this pack.

presets.description:
Type the line, pick the mood, and get the character saying it, spoken exactly, then silence. IndexTTS 2.5 speaks your quoted line in the voice you supply and MiniMax H3 lip-syncs the reference character to it.

This is the Emotion TTS Lip-Sync card with one fix. The card adds a hidden instruction that makes H3 copy the cloned speech instead of inventing its own. On the first card that instruction was a sentence, and on short lines H3 spoke part of it ("... as the final audio track ...") into the time after the line. Here it is only the bare marker <Audio 1>: fully_copy.

With the same voice, picture and line, a 7 word line in a 6 s shot came back word-exact on 3 of 3 seeds (the first card: 0 of 3), then the lips closed and there was silence for the rest of the shot. Silence padding was tested too and is not needed.

Audio slot: a voice sample, 3-10 s of clean speech from the voice you want. It is cloned, not lip-synced. Any language works; the line is spoken in English.

Reference images: the character or characters, up to nine.

Prompt: a normal H3 shot description with the line in double quotes. The first quoted text is what gets spoken. Still describe the lips closing after the line and what she does for the rest of the shot.

Emotion (optional): an [emotion: ...] tag in plain words, such as [emotion: angry, clipped]. It is removed before H3 sees the prompt. Without it the emotion comes from the voice sample.

Duration: fit it to the line. IndexTTS speaks about 3-5 words a second, and a line too long for the shot gets rushed or cut off at the start: a 22 word line in a 6 s shot lost its opening words on both cards. Keep to one or two sentences per shot.

About 2.5 minutes per 6 s shot at 480p, including the voice clone.

The downloads and dependency are the same as the first card's: the IndexTTS node downgrades the engine's transformers, and any future pack that pins transformers 5 will conflict with this one. Requires SimpliGen 1.59.2 or newer.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 TTS Lip-Sync (Fit to Shot)
presets.description:
Works like the Emotion TTS Lip-Sync card, with one difference: the spoken line is paced to fill the shot.

Try the prompt fix first. When your line is shorter than the duration, H3 fills the leftover time by repeating and mangling it, but a prompt solves that completely: describe the lips closing as an event, claim the remaining time with an observable end state, and name the repetition as a prohibition. The Emotion TTS Lip-Sync card's description has the exact wording. That route keeps natural delivery and lets you hold a real silence after the line, which makes it the better answer in most shots.

Use this card instead when you would rather not write that wording every time. It tells IndexTTS the duration up front, so the line is re-generated at a fitted speaking rate that fills the shot and leaves no gap to invent into. There is nothing extra to put in the prompt.

The trade: because the speech is stretched or compressed to reach the shot length, you can never hold a deliberate pause. The line occupies the whole duration, and the delivery speed is whatever the duration demands rather than what the line wants.

Limits: the fitted rate is clamped to 0.5x-2.0x and the node's author recommends 0.8x-1.25x, so a line within about a quarter of the shot length either way sounds natural. Past that it starts to sound rushed or drawn out, so shorten or lengthen the line rather than leaning on the fitter. Fitting usually costs a second TTS pass, so expect roughly double the IndexTTS time. The H3 video pass is unchanged.

The voice sample in the audio slot, the quoted line, the [emotion: ...] tag, the reference images and the automatic <Audio 1> binding all work as on the Emotion TTS Lip-Sync card.

Three lines of 29, 39 and 55 words in a 13 s shot all came back complete and intelligible, with speech filling 88-93% of the shot. Long durations are demanding on a 12 GB card: the TTS model stays in VRAM while H3 stages, so a 13 s shot can run out of VRAM. Close other GPU applications, or drop the duration.

The IndexTTS node downgrades the engine's transformers, and any future pack that pins transformers 5 will conflict with this one. Requires SimpliGen 1.59.2 or newer.

IndexTTS-2.5 model licence: IndexTeam, see the DISCLAIMER in the model repo. The node sets accept_model_license for you.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.
